name: Turn café and bakery dish photos into ASMR AI food videos with Kling 3.0 and SocialRobot

parameters.content:
## Turn a dish photo into an ASMR AI food video

For cafés, bakeries and restaurants: upload one real photo of a dish, pastry or drink and get a 10-second vertical food ASMR video with natural sound, cut into up to 3 close-up shots. SocialRobot sends it to your TikTok inbox as a draft. Instagram Reel, Facebook Reel and Threads are ready to switch on.

### How it works
1. **When Dish Photo Submitted** takes the photo, the dish name, ingredients, price, availability and your business name.
2. The photo goes to fal storage and is center-cropped to 9:16 (Kling takes the video shape from the photo).
3. Optional: OpenAI looks at the photo and writes the shot prompts and captions, using only the facts you typed. Without OpenAI, template shots and captions are used.
4. One Kling 3.0 Standard job renders every shot in a single clip with native audio. The workflow polls, stops after 30 min and cancels the job on timeout.
5. File size and the real MP4 duration are checked, then SocialRobot saves the TikTok draft.
6. Any failure stops with one readable message.

### Setup steps
- [ ] Install the SocialRobot community node `@socialrobot-io/n8n-nodes-socialrobot` (3.1.1+, works on n8n Cloud) and add your SocialRobot API key
- [ ] Connect TikTok in SocialRobot and pick the account in **Draft TikTok Food Video**
- [ ] Add your fal API key as a **Header Auth** credential: name `Authorization`, value `Key YOUR_FAL_KEY`. Select it in every fal HTTP node
- [ ] Add an OpenAI credential to **OpenAI Luna GPT-6**, or set `use_openai` to false
- [ ] Review **Configure Video Settings**

Runs on n8n Cloud and self-hosted. No ffmpeg or Execute Command node.

### Customization
- `shot_count` (1-3) and `video_seconds` (3-15); the seconds are split across the shots.
- `generate_audio`, the three template shot prompts, `prompt_guardrails`, `negative_prompt`.
- `caption_language`, `caption_tone`, `extra_hashtags`, `ai_label_line`, `business_footer`.
- Kling 3.0 Pro: set `video_model` to `fal-ai/kling-video/v3/pro/image-to-video` and update the prices.
- Turn on the optional posts (disabled by default).

### Cost per run (fal list prices, 21 Oct 2026)
Kling 3.0 Standard with audio is $0.126/s, so the default 10 s video is **$1.26**. 5 s = $0.63, 15 s = $1.89. Audio off: $0.084/s ($0.84 for 10 s). fal lists the crop utility at $0. OpenAI adds a few cents.

## 1. Collect the dish
**When Dish Photo Submitted** is the form. **Configure Video Settings** holds every value you'd want to change, including the model id and prices. **If Dish Photo Exists** makes sure an image was uploaded.

## 2. Read the photo
**Organize Dish Photo** picks the uploaded image. **Design Vertical Crop for Photo** reads its size and plans a centered 9:16 crop.

## 3. Host the photo on fal
**Post for fal Upload URL** asks fal storage for an upload URL, **Setup Photo for fal Upload** puts the photo next to it, and **Upload Photo to fal Storage** uploads it.

## 4. Crop and check
**Send Crop Request to fal** makes the 9:16 frame on fal. **Validate Photo on fal** catches upload or crop problems and **Switch by Food Video Plan** picks OpenAI or the template prompts from `use_openai`.

## 5. Shots and captions (optional OpenAI)
**Create Shot Prompts and Captions** sees the cropped photo and writes 1-3 shot prompts plus TikTok, Instagram, Facebook and Threads captions. It may only use the facts from the form. **Format Shot Details** keeps the answer in shape. If OpenAI fails, the template shots and captions take over.

## 6. Queue the Kling video
**Build Kling Video Request** builds one request (multi-shot, native audio, guardrails added to every shot) and adds the AI label to every caption. **Submit Video Job to Kling** queues it on fal, **Verify Video Job Queued** checks fal accepted it and **If Video Job Queued** starts polling.

## Switching to Kling 4.0 later
The model id lives in one place: `video_model` in **Configure Video Settings**. fal lists `fal-ai/kling-video/v4/image-to-video` at $0.157/s (21 Oct 2026). To switch, change `video_model` and `price_per_second_usd`, then test one run. **Build Kling Video Request** sends Kling 3.0 extras (audio, negative prompt, cfg) only to v3 endpoints, and sends durations as the strings v3 expects or the integers v4 expects. Check the endpoint's input fields on fal before switching.

## 7. Wait for the render
**Wait for Video Queue** and **Fetch Video Job Status** check fal every 15 s. **Assess Video Job Status** marks the job done, failed or timed out (30 min) and **Switch by Video Job Status** sends it on. Timeouts cancel the fal job.

## 8. Fetch and check the video
**Retrieve Video Result from fal** gets the clip and **Download Video File from fal** downloads it. **Check Video Specs** reads the real MP4 duration and size, and **If Video Specs OK** only lets a good file through to SocialRobot.

## 9. Save the TikTok draft
**Draft TikTok Food Video** uses Post Mode *Send to Inbox (Draft)*. Nothing is public until you post it in the TikTok app. **Summarize Food Video** lists the cost estimate and next steps.

## Optional posts (disabled)
Connected and **disabled by default**. Enable a node and pick an account; it publishes when the run finishes.
- **Publish Instagram Reel**: Reel with Instagram's AI label on
- **Post Facebook Reel**: Facebook Reel
- **Share Threads Video**: Threads video, caption kept under 500 characters

## AI label and honest food content
- Kling makes new frames from your real photo. Every caption ends with `ai_label_line` ("AI-generated video made from our real photo."), and **Publish Instagram Reel** has **AI-Generated Content** on.
- The node can't set TikTok's AI label on inbox drafts: turn on 'AI-generated content' in TikTok before you post.
- Prompts tell Kling to keep the dish exactly as photographed: no extra toppings, bigger portions or new ingredients. Watch the clip next to the real dish. If it looks better than what you serve, don't post it.
- Captions only use the facts you typed: no invented ingredients, prices, allergens or diet claims, and no reviews or testimonials.
- No people: the prompts and negative prompt exclude people, hands and faces.

## Handle errors
A missing photo, upload or crop problems, a rejected or failed Kling job, timeouts, download errors, files that fail the checks and SocialRobot errors all end in **Log Food Video Errors** with one readable message, then **Halt on Video Error**. **Cancel fal Video Job** cancels the fal job first when it timed out. Add an error workflow in the settings for alerts.

assignments.name: negative_prompt
assignments.value: people, person, hands, fingers, arms, face, body, added ingredients, extra toppings, different dish, bigger portion, text, letters, logo, watermark, speech, voice, talking, singing, music, blur, distortion, warped plate, low quality

assignments.name: prompt_guardrails
assignments.value: Keep the dish, plate and background exactly as photographed, with no added or removed ingredients or toppings. No people, hands or faces. No text or logos. Natural food sounds only, no speech or music.

assignments.name: shot_1_prompt
assignments.value: Slow cinematic macro push-in toward the {dish}, shallow depth of field, soft natural window light, subtle natural movement in the food. Sound: close-up food ASMR, soft crisp textures, quiet cafe ambience.

assignments.name: shot_2_prompt
assignments.value: Extreme close-up slow pan across the texture of the {dish} with a gentle rack focus from the front edge to the center. Sound: delicate crunchy, crackling food ASMR, quiet cafe ambience.

assignments.name: shot_3_prompt
assignments.value: Slow half orbit around the {dish} on its plate, ending on a clean hero framing. Warm natural light, same table and background. Sound: soft food ASMR textures and quiet cafe ambience.

assignments.name: caption_tone
assignments.value: Warm, simple and appetizing. Short sentences. No hype or superlatives.

assignments.name: ai_label_line
assignments.value: AI-generated video made from our real photo.

parameters.text:
=You plan a short vertical food ASMR video for a small café, bakery or restaurant, and write its social captions.
The attached image is the business's own REAL photo of the dish. An image-to-video model (Kling) will animate this exact photo, so the first frame is the photo.

Facts from the business (the ONLY facts you may use in captions):
Dish name: {{ $('When Dish Photo Submitted').first().json['Dish Name'] }}
Ingredients: {{ $('When Dish Photo Submitted').first().json['Ingredients'] || 'not given' }}
Price: {{ $('When Dish Photo Submitted').first().json['Price'] || 'not given' }}
Availability: {{ $('When Dish Photo Submitted').first().json['Availability'] || 'not given' }}
Business: {{ $('When Dish Photo Submitted').first().json['Business Name'] }}
Location or link: {{ $('When Dish Photo Submitted').first().json['Location or Link'] || 'not given' }}
Caption language: {{ $('Configure Video Settings').first().json.caption_language }}. Tone: {{ $('Configure Video Settings').first().json.caption_tone }}

Return:
- visible_dish: one sentence describing only what you can see in the photo.
- shots: exactly {{ Math.min(3, Math.max(1, Math.round(Number($('Configure Video Settings').first().json.shot_count) || 1))) }} objects, each {"prompt": "..."}, in English, under 300 characters each, for a {{ $('Configure Video Settings').first().json.video_seconds }}-second clip cut into that many shots. Each prompt describes one slow, close, appetizing camera move on THIS dish (for example a macro push-in, a slow pan across the texture, a rack focus, a slow orbit, a top-down slow rotation) plus natural motion and the ASMR sound that fits it (soft crackle of pastry, crunch, gentle sizzle, bubbles, a slow pour, quiet café ambience).
- tiktok_caption: under 300 characters, ending with 3-5 hashtags that include {{ $('Configure Video Settings').first().json.extra_hashtags }}.
- instagram_caption: under 600 characters, short lines, hashtags at the end (include {{ $('Configure Video Settings').first().json.extra_hashtags }}).
- facebook_caption: under 500 characters, at most 2 hashtags.
- threads_caption: under 350 characters, at most 1 hashtag.

Rules for the shots:
- Keep the dish exactly as photographed: same ingredients, toppings, garnish, portion size, plate, table and background. Never add, remove, enlarge or restyle anything.
- No people at all: no hands, fingers, arms, faces or bodies. Nothing is picked up, cut, bitten or served by a person, and utensils do not move on their own.
- Only show a pour, drizzle, dusting or melt if that sauce, syrup, drink or topping is already clearly visible in the photo, and let it come from above, out of frame, without making the portion bigger.
- Steam only if the food looks hot. No text, logos, labels or watermarks. Realistic light, no fast moves, no fisheye.
- Sound: natural food and café sounds only. No speech, voices, singing or music.

Rules for the captions:
- Use only the facts above. Do not invent ingredients, flavours, allergens, diet or health claims (vegan, gluten-free, healthy, organic), origin, 'homemade', 'freshly baked', awards, discounts or prices.
- Write the price and availability exactly as given, or leave them out if not given.
- No reviews, ratings, quotes, testimonials or claims about what customers say. No superlatives like 'best in town'.
- Do not say the video was filmed. Do not write an AI disclosure or disclaimer: one is added automatically.
